headline: MIN @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 4.36 at TEX 4.43, with a projected total of 8.80. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIN: MIN moved +0.71 runs while TEX moved -0.33, changing the projected margin by +1.04 runs. The projected total climbed +0.44, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Joe Ryan has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Byron Buxton, Josh Bell, Kody Clemens, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ryan Kreidler because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
